component.name: RaceWave46
component.summary: Wave Race 64 recompiled for modern systems

description.p: RaceWave46 is an unofficial, AI-assisted static recompilation of Wave Race 64, with modern rendering, widescreen presentation, expanded local multiplayer, configurable controls and RetroAchievements.

No game data is included. On first start you select your own unmodified Wave Race 64 USA Rev 1 ROM from the main menu; it is checked and copied into the application's private data, and later starts only need Start Game.
